title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta22

## US account connection fix

US accounts could fail to connect with Passport error `90060` (version too low)
because authentication tried a legacy US server before the official app's
current US endpoint.

This beta prioritizes `api-passport-ore.willand.com` for US account discovery,
sign-in and token refresh. Both `us` and `ore` select this route, while the raw
account region is preserved for the mower-cloud session. Existing regional
fallbacks remain available after transport failures.

The Passport app version, signing algorithm, mower-cloud routing and MQTT
configuration are unchanged. No Map Card update is required.

After installing, restart Home Assistant. If Home Assistant still requests
reauthentication, complete it using the existing Navimow account.

### Validation

Permanent offline regressions cover US discovery, `us`/`ore` sign-in, refresh
from serialized tokens, EU routing, regional transport fallback and terminal
authentication errors. The tests reproduce the legacy-host `90060` failure
before the routing change. Prior protocol investigation verified the official
US endpoint with the existing app identity; a full live Home Assistant
restart/login/refresh cycle remains a field-validation item for this beta.
